newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS TO SELL UNIT TO SIGNAUX .
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS TO SELL UNIT TO SIGNAUX .

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday it planned to sell its Philips Datacommunication (DAC) unit to France's Compagnie des Signaux.
Philips said the deal, part of a previously announced review of the company's operations, was expected to be completed in the first quarter of next year.
DAC, which Philips said no longer fits in with its range of operations, develops and makes telecommmunication equipment as well as engineering local and wide area network systems.
The Philips unit's 700 employees generated sales of 254 million guilders in 1995.
